checks.name: Review
checks.detail:
All criteria met; no unmet points.

AC1: the rewrite is prompt text only in insightRequest (sessionInsights.ts): preamble, headline schema line, did schema line, turns rule, headline/summary/outcome_type rules, and the "Deployed fix, confirmed memory stable" example replaced by a measured result. Golden insight.json regenerated; `bun test convex/sessionInsights.request.test.ts` 4/4. No filter, retry, second call or parse guard. Freezes and judges untouched by the diff (the 0706ea1a judge was sharpened earlier, not loosened).
AC2: only done steps go in did; running/waiting steps are never done/passed/verified; announced-next steps are neither done nor underway (summary names them as next); one result per bullet, mixed bullets claim only the shown part; headline claims only finished work. A completion notice is not a pass.
AC3: shipped needs the excerpt to show deployed/merged/complete; progress covers a last step not shown finishing.
AC4: run of record (eval-result.json, 08:57, haiku-4-5, 5 reps): miss 0706ea1a base 0/5 -> branch 4/5; 79b1a58a 3/5 -> 5/5; guards 8157ae70, c0c50f98, 23d5e903 5/5 on branch; no gate failures, 0 crashes; separated: better (p=2.9e-5). My own `./evals check insight --reps 5` on the branch: 24/25, 0706ea1a 5/5, 79b1a58a 5/5, c0c50f98 5/5, 8157ae70 5/5, 23d5e903 4/5 (one rep at 0.60; passes by majority, a note), no gates, not separated vs the prior branch run set (medians 0.93/0.93), not worse.
AC5: `cast check convex` 0 errors in the branch worktree.

Note: one branch rep on 0706ea1a in the run of record still wrote "modal appears when clicked"; my 5 reps had none. Isolated, not repeating.

P12 checklist: P5 pass (each rule rewritten at its own site), P1 pass (opens with reader and intent), P2 pass (one call, one schema), P3 pass (example swap removes the anchoring "confirmed" closer; no new examples), P4 pass (reads clean, no history), P8 n/a, P9 pass (red on base, green on branch, same freezes, guards held, judges not loosened), P10 n/a (context unchanged), P11 pass (the earlier "tests underway" swing on c0c50f98 is gone: 5/5 in both runs).
Principles checked: PR-prompt-1, PR-prompt-3, PR-code-1, PR-process-7, CC-verify-2, CC-ship-2.
